title: Life Dashboard Companion webhook payload
description: Health Connect payload POSTed to configured webhooks. Only enabled data types with records appear; every record additionally carries optional source and uuid fields. The same schema is used by the iOS companion app (source: healthkit_ios).

sequence.description: Increases with every payload this install sends, health_connect and screen_time alike (one counter, so per source it can skip). A receiver that keeps the highest sequence it has applied per source can ignore an older health_connect payload that arrives late after a retry. For screen_time compare per date instead: each payload re-sends a sliding week, so a late one can still hold the oldest date that no newer payload covers; keep the sequence that last wrote each date and apply a day only from a payload with a higher one. Optional: 1.20.0 and older send none on screen_time payloads and healthkit_ios may omit it, so treat a missing field as unknown rather than zero.

deleted_records.description: Records Health Connect deleted since the previous sync. Absent when there are none. A receiver should drop the record with this uuid from the named collection.

type.description: The payload key the record arrived under, e.g. nutrition

uuid.description: The uuid the record was delivered with

deletions_unavailable.description: Types whose deletion tracking was interrupted, because the phone did not sync for over 30 days. Deletions in that gap were never observed; reconcile these types against a completed backfill window instead. Absent when nothing was interrupted.

records_outside_window.description: Per payload key, records that a source wrote or edited since the previous sync with a timestamp before the range this sync read (read_from in _diagnostics), so they are not in the payload: for instance a watch that uploads after more than a week away from the phone. A backfill of from to until sends them. Absent when there are none.

count.description: How many such changes Health Connect reported

from.description: Timestamp of the oldest of them

until.description: Where the range the sync read started

test.description: Present, and true, only on a test ping: a POST that proves the address and the secret work and carries no records, only timestamp, app_version, source and message besides. Sent by Test ping on the tabs, by the setup wizard and right after a QR pairing.

message.description: Human readable text of a test ping; absent on every other payload

backfill.description: True on payloads from a one-time history export; absent on ordinary syncs

window_start.description: Backfill only: start of the window this payload belongs to

window_end.description: Backfill only: end of the window this payload belongs to

window_complete.description: Backfill only: true on the last payload of a window, meaning every record the phone holds for that window has now been sent. A receiver may treat uuids it holds in that range that were not in the window as deleted. False means the window was split and more is coming.

_diagnostics.description: Per-type read diagnostics; see README. Since 1.20.0 each entry also carries own_records_skipped: records this app wrote itself (Receive) that were left out of the payload. read_from is where the time range read for the type started; lookback_gap_from is null unless the phone did not sync for so long that the range could not reach back far enough, and then records timestamped from lookback_gap_from up to read_from that were written or edited in that time were not read (a backfill of that range recovers them).

writeback.description: Health Connect payloads to the Life Dashboard integration only, when Receive is on (1.20.0): what the phone can write, and the outcome of what the integration sent last time. Absent on every other payload. The integration's answer is described in webhook.md under Inbound.

types.description: The types switched on and permitted; the integration sends readings of these only

history.description: True when the phone accepts measurements older than 30 days

ack.description: Ids of readings written since the previous request

failed.description: Readings not written, each with a code; never a value

items.description: A raw record, or an aggregate when this series has a resolution set

source.description: Package name of the app that wrote the record to Health Connect

uuid.description: Stable record id for server-side deduplication

bucket_start.description: Start of the window, aligned to the clock in UTC

sample_count.description: Records that went into this window, so a receiver can tell a sparse bucket from a full one
